items.summary: Recommend no new monetization, spend, or production admissions this cycle. Amazon evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission, all under an aggregate unattributed row; named site rows show $0 site-attributed commission. Do not present this as site revenue, forecast, ROI, margin, or causal lift. The recorded AI window for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-30 is $1,002.45979265 across 5,531 calls with 234 errors; it is not period-comparable to the one-day revenue extract. Preserve the capacity gate and execute only already-approved work after a slot is released.

Contribution margin, site-level ROI, and cost-to-learn are not calculable from the brief. Minimum measurement: aligned daily revenue and AI, infrastructure, domain, and other direct costs by site and workflow; stable tracking-ID/content mapping; shipped commission rather than ordered-item counts; and a ledger of validated learnings tied to experiment or improvement IDs. Until then, use only recorded AI spend as cost exposure and label revenue as unattributed or unknown.

Budget exposure is visible but budget variance is unknown: recorded AI cost is $1,002.46 for September 2026, while monthly spend limit, fixed costs, marketing budget, and revenue floor are blank. Do not infer authorization, runway, or affordability. Minimum measurement: owner-approved budget ceilings plus daily actuals for AI, infrastructure, domains, and marketing reconciled to those ceilings. No money movement, billing changes, banking access, or contracts are authorized.

Clicks, impressions, sessions, ordered items, SEO conversions, and shipped items are operating indicators, not supported revenue or profit claims. The 2026-09-21 Amazon row has 28 ordered items but only 6 shipped items and $4.92 aggregate commission, with no site assignment. Preserve the distinction between traffic, affiliate clicks, orders, shipped items, commission, and contribution margin in all executive reporting.
